reviews.text:
I visited for treatment of my bird.

Thank you so much for your kind and considerate care.

Thank you for your review.

We will continue to do our best to meet your expectations, so please continue to support us. We look forward to seeing you again.

Everyone at this hospital, from the receptionists to the doctors, is so kind and polite, I'm so grateful! They always treat my bird kindly when I leave it at the pet hotel, so I highly recommend this hospital for caring for not only dogs and cats, but also small birds.

When I went for the first time at the end of last year, the doctor was a woman and was very considerate.
The nurses were all very polite and I got the impression that they really cared about animals when examining them.

This was my second visit this year, and I made an appointment for a second opinion and consultation.
The doctor was a man, and I thought he was a little unfriendly as soon as I entered the examination room. I was a little worried that the previous doctor would be better, but I started the examination anyway.
After a lot of ultrasounds and other things, the doctor gave me the same diagnosis as our current veterinary hospital. He said he could even refer me to a larger hospital, handed me a pamphlet, and that was the end of it.
When I asked if I wanted the injury drained and disinfected, I was told, "We don't have time, so please take it and come back later. There are other customers."
I was told there was only a 30-minute wait per person, but I showed up on time and told him the symptoms, and they even did the same procedure for me at the end of the year, but the doctor didn't do it, right?

Are you just going to let me go home without doing anything? When I said that, the doctor sighed and said, "Okay, I'll do it," with a sour look on his face, and began draining the pus. But when the nurse asked if they were going to disinfect the wound with Hibitane or Isodine afterwards, she said they wouldn't do that because it wasn't an open wound.

While they were draining the pus, the receptionist came in and said, "Mr./Ms. X said he couldn't wait until this time," and she replied, "I can't!", so I thought she didn't want to take up the time to disinfect the wound because she didn't have time.

I explained the situation clearly over the phone and when I arrived, but she kept saying, "I thought you just wanted a second opinion," and she kept chuckling and looking annoyed as she examined me. I couldn't hide my surprise at how different she was from the first time I went.

I was also surprised that the receptionist didn't even bother to tell Chinese people to stop talking loudly in the waiting room when their phones were on speaker.
Overall, my first visit was great, so I'm very disappointed. I won't be going again, but if I do, I think it's important to make sure you know who will be examining you. It's a very unpleasant experience.

My bird is being taken care of here. 
The teacher is very kind. It's conveniently located nearby.

I had my male budgie examined here.
The service was incredibly polite, and even though I had delayed making the decision to go to the hospital, the vet carefully chose his words and spoke to me kindly so that I wouldn't feel that way. His explanations were easy to understand, and he even made detailed notes for me, explaining various measures and options in detail.
Thanks to him, I've been able to bring him back from the brink of death many times.
However, yesterday, due to a mistake on our part, we delayed taking him to the hospital, and we only visited after it was too late. I couldn't even answer when they asked about his most recent weight. I had neglected to weigh him daily, citing busyness and optimism. I'm a terrible owner. I only thought I cherished him, but perhaps I didn't deserve to own a pet. As a vet, I'm sure I caused him frustration by not being able to act sooner. I'm truly sorry. Even so, despite the fact that the vet was open after hours, he was flexible and responded appropriately.
We performed the cremation today, but at least I think my parakeet was very happy to be able to be treated at Mogu Animal Hospital.

Testicular tumors are a very scary disease.

If you notice symptoms such as your parakeet puffing up its feathers and staying still, it's best to head to this hospital immediately.

I was unable to save a life that I could have saved, and now I deeply regret my own poor judgment in terms of how I kept it.

Parakeets' conditions can deteriorate rapidly once they become ill. I don't want anyone to go through the same regrets as me.

Whenever I came near him, he would spread his wings and exercise, dancing as if he wanted to play, and I always felt comforted and reassured. It was something I took for granted, but it's gone now.

Thank you, doctor.

I am so grateful.

I hope that this story will be of some help to other bird owners who read this comment.

Thank you for your feedback.

We will continue to strive to meet your expectations, so we look forward to your continued support. We await your next visit.

This is the animal hospital where we took our cat for treatment. The veterinarian here is not only very thorough in their examinations, but also incredibly kind and always considers things from the animal's perspective. During consultations, they listen carefully to what we have to say, noticing even the slightest changes and concerns, which gives us a great sense of reassurance.

When our cat fell ill, we took her here for treatment, and the treatment choices were spot-on, resulting in a full recovery. Seeing her recovered, I truly felt that we had made the right decision in entrusting her to this veterinarian.

Occasionally, the veterinarian has a serious expression during examinations, which can be a little unsettling at times. However, this expression stems from their serious assessment of the animal's condition, and ultimately leads to accurate diagnoses and treatments. In fact, I think this attitude is a testament to their professionalism and trustworthiness.

A reassuring animal hospital where you can receive thorough care from a kind veterinarian. Our cat recovered, and the service was perfect. Five stars, I'm incredibly grateful.

My elderly cat had acute symptoms, and since our regular vet was closed, we urgently visited this animal hospital.

The medical care and the staff's service were excellent.

* The clinic was very clean, bright, and had a stylish interior, creating a calming atmosphere.

* The doctor presented several treatment options, explaining the risks of each and allowing the owner to choose, which gave us peace of mind.

* My cat is the type that struggles and tries to bite, so we caused quite a bit of trouble, but the staff were kind and gentle throughout.

My cat has sometimes been treated poorly at other clinics, so seeing them speak kindly to her even when she was struggling almost brought me to tears.

I heard there's a way to prevent her from struggling by giving her medication at home before the visit, so I'd like to try that.

Thank you so much for everything.

Thank you for your feedback.

We will do our best to ensure that both the animals and their owners are satisfied, so we look forward to your continued support.
Great hospital that takes great care of your pets!

My beloved dog and cat received excellent care here.

The nurses and veterinarians were all very kind, and I think that was conveyed to the animals.

My dog ​​wagged its tail happily whenever it saw the veterinarians, and my cat, who usually struggles when I try to trim its claws, was very well-behaved when the veterinarian was doing it.

We had them look after our pets for about five days while we were on our honeymoon. They allowed our friendly dogs and cats to play together in the same room during the day, and we were able to spend our time there with peace of mind.

We've moved and are now using a local veterinary clinic, but if we ever live in Shinjuku again, I would definitely like to come back here.
It was really good.

I have one dog and two cats here. They examine them thoroughly, paying attention to even the smallest details. The staff are all kind and friendly. It's also convenient that you can make reservations online.

The clinic was clean, and the doctor was very kind!
Cockatiels have sensitive personalities, so I'm still considering using their pet hotel service, but if they had a pet camera or a messaging app like Line, I think I'd feel even more at ease knowing they could send me updates on my bird's condition.

My late wife was a bird lover.

She had visited many animal hospitals in Tokyo over a long period of time, and she always said that this hospital was the best because they treated birds so well.

In fact, I've also used their services.

I'm still a novice bird lover, and I haven't been to any other animal hospitals, so I can't really compare, but I think it's a good hospital where they are kind and teach you many things.

Thank you for your review.

We will continue to strive to provide you with a safe and comfortable experience, and we appreciate your continued support.

Thank you for your continued support. Everyone is so kind and genuinely cares about the animals, and I trust you completely.

My dog ​​loves the hospital (and the doctors) because the doctors and staff are so gentle! Whenever we pass the hospital on our walk, he always peeks in the mirror to check if there are any staff members at the reception! (laughs)
I recently got a cat, and I'd like to have her cared for here as well!

Recently, there's been construction on the surrounding buildings, so I'm worried they might be moving.

I visited for the first time today to get a rabies vaccine. The director was rather straightforward, but he was very efficient and seemed very experienced, so I felt more at ease here than at another hospital I had previously visited. The female staff were also friendly and very kind. The clinic has a homey, clean atmosphere and seems popular, as many people rush in right from the start of opening hours.
I'm sorry for the inconvenience caused by my timid dog accidentally wetting himself, but I'll be sure to use your services again in the future.

Thank you for your review. 
We will continue to provide medical care that will put your dogs, cats, and pets and their families at ease, so we look forward to seeing you again.

I've been taking my boyfriend's cat here for just under a year. Even though I first brought him in in a terrible condition, they didn't get angry and gave me lots of advice. I'm so grateful.

(Looking at the fresh wounds on the staff's arms, I can see how hard they work... Keep it up!)

Reservations are the norm, but they'll be flexible and make emergency arrangements if your dog isn't feeling well (though they might not be able to accommodate if they're too busy).
The female staff are all very kind to the animals and love to pat them on the back.
They even remembered my dog's name, which made me really happy.

I visited your clinic three times.

It's a pet and owner-first clinic; they listened attentively to my concerns, and even though my pet was unwell and the consultation was conducted solely via video, they watched the video until the very end. They provided various treatments and advice, but sadly, my pet passed away. We held the funeral today. Thank you so much.

I am truly grateful.

I took my 2-year-old cat to the vet for watery diarrhea and a runny nose. The vet was very helpful, adjusting the medication and giving her injections to treat the persistent diarrhea. In about a week, she was almost completely recovered. Her appetite has even improved, and she's become much more energetic.

The vet was very thorough in her examination, which put my mind at ease. Thank you very much.
Thank you for your review. We look forward to seeing you again!

Thank you for posting your review.
We will do our best to provide consultations that live up to the reviews.
We look forward to your continued support.
Your polite and kind service is a great help! Thank you 😊 …
The doctor was kind, and I felt at ease having my children examined there.

My dog ​​is timid and doesn't like men, so I was able to specify a female veterinarian, and when we actually went, she was more considerate and gentle than I expected, so my dog ​​seemed much less afraid than when we went to other veterinarians. I'm very grateful.
She also explained things to the owner in a thorough, easy-to-understand manner, and her friendly attitude made me feel very at ease.
